verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־ אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh ’aš·rê- ’îš yā·rê ’eṯ- Yah·weh bə·miṣ·wō·ṯāw ḥā·p̄êṣ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Blessed is the man who fears the LORD who greatly delights in His commandments

verses.original: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: gib·bō·wr bā·’ā·reṣ yih·yeh zar·‘ōw dō·wr yə·šā·rîm yə·ḇō·rāḵ
verses.literal: His descendants will be mighty in the land the generation of the upright will be blessed

verses.original: הוֹן־ וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.literal: Wealth and riches are in his house and his righteousness endures forever

verses.original: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: zā·raḥ ba·ḥō·šeḵ ’ō·wr lay·šā·rîm ḥan·nūn wə·ra·ḥūm wə·ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright for the gracious compassionate and righteous

verses.original: טֽוֹב־ אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- ’îš ḥō·w·nên ū·mal·weh yə·ḵal·kêl də·ḇā·rāw bə·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely whose affairs are guided by justice

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־ יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lə·‘ō·w·lām lō- yim·mō·wṭ lə·zê·ḵer ‘ō·w·lām yih·yeh ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: Surely he will never . . . be shaken the righteous man will be remembered forever

verses.original: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šə·mū·‘āh rā·‘āh lō yî·rā nā·ḵō·wn lib·bōw bā·ṭu·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: He does not fear bad news his heart is steadfast trusting in the LORD

verses.original: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־ יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: sā·mūḵ lib·bōw lō yî·rā ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- yir·’eh ḇə·ṣā·rāw
verses.literal: His heart is assured he does not fear until he looks in triumph on his foes

verses.original: פִּזַּ֤ר׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: piz·zar nā·ṯan lā·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw ‘ō·me·ḏeṯ lā·‘aḏ qar·nōw tā·rūm bə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor his righteousness endures forever his horn will be lifted high in honor

verses.original: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ yir·’eh wə·ḵā·‘ās šin·nāw ya·ḥă·rōq wə·nā·mās ta·’ă·waṯ rə·šā·‘îm tō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: The wicked man will see and be grieved he will gnash his teeth and waste away the desires of the wicked will perish
